tasks.title: REL-BGSTAB-007 checkpoint-protocol strict RED failures and safety-regression provenance
tasks.action: Commit 97e3e5b2c9ec004ac73a243909dc3650a88a77c4 is passing safety-regression provenance, not RED evidence: shadow-disabled registration must remain explicit legacy/fail-closed with no synthetic checkpoint and stale generation-1 failure ACK after generation 2 must remain rejected while a matching generation-2 failure ACK rolls back. Noncanonical apply-ACK parser rejection is an AC-4 baseline guard, not a fresh-resync RED. Before this test-only task begins, create a separate safety-restoration commit that reverts provisional 0134df9 only in SessionManager.ts and TerminalAuthorityProductionAdapter.ts. The strict RED gate then records only two real WsRouter paths. The existing AC-9 test must make its synchronous A→B→C trigger against the actual negotiated stale view clientId returned by connectNegotiatedAuthorityView, not a literal placeholder; this test-only correction is mandatory before GREEN and must itself produce the selected two-case RED result. For AC-9, it must register its test observer before installing wrappers, then wrap the public SessionManager.addRetainedTerminalDriverLeaseHandoffListener call used by the adapter and the public clearTerminalAuthorityRuntimeFactory call, counting their returned adapter disposer and runtime-factory clear respectively. Its observer synchronously re-enters A→B as B→C, then proves only current C receives an exact responder identity, receives an accepted query receipt, reaches the PTY exactly once, and invokes SessionManager.writeTerminalAuthorityCompatibilityQueryReply zero times through an instrumented public-boundary wrapper. Before the C query ingress, it must call the public SessionManager.acceptTerminalAuthorityLegacyBrowserQueryReply controller path with stale B's exact identity and prove that call is rejected without a PTY write; the C ingress then proves the controller path accepts only current C rather than a direct fallback. It must invoke the same integration.destroy() twice without throwing, assert the adapter listener disposer count and runtime-factory clear count are each exactly one after both calls, then perform a further valid manager handoff and prove no responder-enabled frame is sent. For AC-5, it must inject one PTY output before checkpoint activation, assert commit.sourceSeq is a canonical positive ordinal, derive `drainedThroughSeq = (BigInt(sourceSeq) - 1n).toString()`, prove input is fenced before apply, after valid apply, and after that canonical stale drain ACK; only the exact canonical `drainedThroughSeq = sourceSeq` may release the queued mutation.
